evidence.source_name: Hot Tin Roof Restaurant — official source
supports: Hot Tin Roof is named for Tennessee Williams' favorite play, Cat on a Hot Tin Roof

It is the signature waterfront fine-dining restaurant at Ocean Key Resort & Spa, serving Key West cuisine with Cuban and Caribbean influences, local seafood and seasonal produce under Executive Chef Scott Maurer
The menu is best savored on the verandah overlooking the harbor and the world-famous sunset
The lounge signature is the Hot Tin Tini, vodka infused with fresh pineapple, alongside a Hemingway Daiquiri with local rum
Dinner is served daily from 6:00 to 9:00 pm, with breakfast Monday-Saturday 8:00-11:30 am and Sunday brunch 11:45 am-12:45 pm
Hot Tin Roof operates as a cashless establishment, accepting all major credit cards and mobile payment options

editorial.hook: Key West cuisine with Cuban and Caribbean influences on a harbor-view verandah
editorial.why_here: Named for Tennessee Williams' favorite play, Cat on a Hot Tin Roof, this is Ocean Key's signature waterfront restaurant. Its menu blends Cuban and Caribbean influences with fresh local seafood and seasonal produce under Executive Chef Scott Maurer.
editorial.know_before: Hot Tin Roof operates as a cashless establishment and accepts all major credit cards and mobile payment options.
editorial.local_tip: Try the signature Hot Tin Tini, vodka infused with fresh pineapple, or the Hemingway Daiquiri in the lounge.
